provenance.source: Camera2 static metadata from dumpsys media.camera
notes: Camera 0 advertises RAW and reports GBRG, black level 256x4, and white level 4095.
D65 gains are derived from ColorTransform1 and the D65 white point.
camera_to_xyz_d65 composes inverse CalibrationTransform1, ForwardMatrix1, and Bradford D50-to-D65 adaptation.
Use per-frame dynamic black/white levels and AWB gains in a future frame-metadata API when available.
